official: 稲城市心身障害者福祉手当に関する条例の一部を改正する条例
name: 心身障害者福祉手当の対象を見直す
summary: 現在は、障害の区分などにより、手当額は15,500円、12,500円、または5,000円です。この議案では、知的障害・身体障害の支給対象を見直し、東京都の手当条例の適用を受ける人に限って15,500円を支給します。改正は令和8年10月1日からで、すでに認定を受けている人には令和10年3月分まで旧制度に沿って支給します。
changes: 知的障害の支給要件を4度以上から3度以上に改める
身体障害の支給要件を4級以上から2級以上に改める
知的・身体障害の手当対象を東京都条例の適用を受ける人に限る
知的・身体障害の手当額を15,500円とし、12,500円・5,000円の区分をなくす
who: 知的・身体障害があり、東京都の手当条例の適用を受けない人
why: 障害者を取り巻く社会環境が変化したことなどを踏まえ、制度を見直すためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Revises eligibility for the mental and physical disability welfare allowance
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Inagi City Ordinance on the Mental and Physical Disability Welfare Allowance
en.summary: The allowance is currently ¥15,500, ¥12,500 or ¥5,000, depending on disability category and other factors. This bill revises eligibility for people with intellectual or physical disabilities and limits the ¥15,500 allowance to people covered by Tokyo's allowance ordinance. The changes take effect on October 1, 2026. People who have already been certified will continue to receive payments under the old system through the March 2028 payment.
changes: Changes the eligibility requirement for intellectual disabilities from Degree 4 or above to Degree 3 or above
Changes the eligibility requirement for physical disabilities from Grade 4 or above to Grade 2 or above
Limits eligibility for the intellectual and physical disability allowance to people covered by Tokyo's allowance ordinance
Sets the allowance for intellectual and physical disabilities at ¥15,500 and eliminates the ¥12,500 and ¥5,000 categories
who: People with a Degree 4 intellectual disability
People with Grade 3 or Grade 4 physical disabilities
People with intellectual or physical disabilities who are not covered by Tokyo's allowance ordinance
en.why: The city says it is reviewing the system in light of changes in the social environment surrounding people with disabilities, among other factors.
